subject: theo
title: NFA → DFA
description: Given an NFA, construct the equivalent DFA. Reachable states only.
promptTemplate: Create an NFA for the powerset construction at level {{level}}. easy: 3 states, alphabet {a,b}, no ε-transitions. medium: 4 states with one ε-transition. exam: 4–5 states, ε-transitions, several final states, worded like an exam question. Give the NFA as a transition table (rows = states, columns = symbols, start state marked →, final states marked *). When checking: first check the ε-closure of the start state, then each row of the DFA table on its own, then the final states.
answerFormat: DFA as a table: state sets like {q0,q1} as rows, one column per symbol, start state marked →, final states marked *.
